title: Connectivity-induced surface-loss penalty in superconducting qubit-coupler lattices
summary: Recent advances in design and fabrication have increased the energy-relaxation times of isolated superconducting transmon qubits to the hundreds-of-microseconds regime, with reported values exceeding 500 $μ$s. However, the same progress has not automatically translated to multiqubit processors, where qubits are embedded in connected qubit-coupler lattices and often exhibit much shorter lifetimes than isolated qubits.
